dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted or persisted.
prepare and validate have no structured entry or completion logging.
Prompt, claim, chronology, and output validation fail before writes.
Injection, claim escalation, persistence, strictness, and workspace behavior are tested.
Model does not invoke an external API.
Preparation records but does not create a workspace or handle.
Public and persisted object contracts are strict.
Both resources declare infinite lifetime and GC retention.
Request and validated-review names are spec-prefixed.
No stored state is read by these transformations.
